findings.issue: The decoded struct fields are read as byte slices of memory and the nested mapping slot stays sha3(sha3(eid, 3)) arithmetic, so the bytes write to enforcedOptions[eid][msgType] reads as writes to stor[_94].
findings.rule: Bytes(32 - n, 0), mem[a + 32 - n len n] is uint(8n)(mem[a]); sha3(k2, sha3(k1, p)) with p a declared mapping slot is m[k1][k2] (print the storage-bytes write against that name).

notes: One source loop (OAppOptionsType3._setEnforcedOptions:42), a readable while in setEnforcedOptions; the implicit calldata decode of the struct array and the event encoding are whiles too (readable, the bytes copies inside them are copy lines), and the storage-bytes write is open-coded (long/short string encoding, copy lines). All 22 functions reviewed (LayerZero OApp plumbing, forwarder sends); immutable endpoint/oracle addresses read as 0 (artifact, normal). No semantic error found.
summary: Clean and faithful; the loop is readable, with struct fields as memory slices and the nested-mapping bytes write left as raw slots.
